# SkyrimNet_SexLab

> SkyrimNet ↔ SexLab bridge for Skyrim SE. Papyrus + action YAML + prompts + optional SKSE WebUI.

## Read by job

| Job | Start here |
|-----|------------|
| Player / FAQ / install | docs/players/overview.md, docs/players/requirements.md, docs/players/hotkeys.md |
| Author actions / scenes | docs/authors/actions.md, docs/reference/scene-settings.md, docs/reference/tag-synonyms.md |
| Author prompts | docs/authors/prompts.md + docs/reference/{json-keys,protocol-tokens,orgasm-narration}.md |
| Author animations | docs/authors/animations.md |
| Stage descriptor prototype (Billyy / SLAL → anidata) | descriptor/README.md |
| Anidata schema 3.0 | docs/developers/anidata-schema.md |
| Develop Papyrus / ESP | docs/developers/papyrus.md, docs/reference/papyrus-rules.md |
| Develop WebUI / SKSE | docs/developers/webui.md (ControlPanel modes, target sentinels, foreign `data_table` / `actor_detail` hosts), docs/reference/extension-panels.md |
| Orgasm / enjoyment / mini-game / Scene HUD / plugin API | docs/developers/orgasm-engine.md |
| Agent policy | AGENTS.md (safety, confidence, commits) |
| Quirks | KNOWLEDGEBASE.md |
| Portable doc-system template (copy to other repos) | documentation-guide.xml |
| Release documentation | release-guide.xml, release-checkpoint.xml |
| Changelog | CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG-user.md |
| Short examples | docs/examples/ (stubs); prefer snippets pointing at SKSE/Plugins/... shipped files |

## Optional examples

- Action YAML: SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/external/goodprovider.sexlab/actions/SexLab_Start_Giving.yaml
- Scene JSON: SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet_SexLab/scenes/no_penis.json, scenes/punish_spanking.json
- Synthetic stub: docs/examples/minimal-scene-setting.json

## Do not ingest (unless debugging that area)

- SSEEdit Cache/
- reviews/ (historical review notes; use review-checkpoint.xml for current constraints)
- Source/*.pex and other loose .pex copies under Source/
- crash-*.log, Papyrus.0.log at repo root
- versions/, dist/, z-* files and directories (user scratch), handler_* unpack dirs if present
- SKSE_Source/build/, SKSE_Source/lib/CommonLibSSE-NG/ (vendored; huge)

## Compile reminders

- Papyrus: Cursor task `compile: pyro` only
- SKSE: CMake tasks under SKSE_Source (see docs/developers/webui.md)
